findings.title: Post-test modification of existing evidence script invalidates governance evidence binding
findings.description: The recorded tested_commit is 4363887168b123fedc3ed9cadcfd7086a36be60b, but the tested-to-reviewed suffix modifies the already existing write_record.py (adds sys.argv revision selection and an ancestry check). The selected governance merge gate permits only additions in the own evidence directory after testing. Independently invoking governance_suffix_errors on the exact tested/reviewed SHAs returns governance-tested-evidence-not-addition:docs/exec-plans/evidence/HG-038/write_record.py. The current review cannot PASS even though the proposed protocol decomposition needs no frozen semantic change.
findings.required_change: Run the required governance checks against a revision containing this script change, bind a new tested_commit and evidence, and obtain new independent reviews. After the newly tested revision append only new evidence and the own governance record; do not edit existing evidence scripts/logs.

protocol_assessment.scope: Governance definitions and prospective test/owner feasibility only; no implementation approval for unstarted tasks.
protocol_assessment.cancellation: Existing CancelIntent owns restricted S27 status mutation and requires S27 update; it has no S32 insertion/ledger accessor. KL026 explicitly terminates the root under S01/intent/reservation then calls actual CancelUndispatched separately. Current cleanup reads only exact RESERVED and updates accounting without business status. The terminal-with-RESERVED intermediate retains occupation while current worker/T6/dispatch authority denies; dispatch-first preserves possible-call occupation and cannot be refunded. This matches Protocol6.5/6.6/6.9 and frozen command ownership.
protocol_assessment.ordinary_pause: Protocol5.5 permits recording pause/stop reason; DB S45 places stopping events in S03 and DB5 requires execution-basis updates for T7 stopping. KL077 restricts ordinary authenticated TEST lifecycle contraction to S01/S44 plus atomic receipt/event/outbox, exact prior START-or-RESUME binding and revision; no new issuance/binding/epoch/head or eligibility grant. S01->S44->receipt takes only needed locks with no registry eligibility dependency. Protective STOP/hold remains independent T2. Existing T7 RESUME requires PAUSED+START, so owner-produced pause and independent lifecycle-valid denial runs address the actual merged guard rather than using raw PAUSE seeds.
protocol_assessment.pipeline: The public registry contains 39 commands, and RecordSnapshot/AdvanceAttempt remain explicitly internal. KL075 adds bounded internal guarded snapshot/stage owners with CREATED->LEASED and exact frozen forward stages; KL076 guards existing preparation owners, computes immutable F->D->N and source-derived certificates; KL077 extends the actual currently synthetic single-TRAINING adapter to full TRAINING/NUTRITION T6 and existing typed CONTINUE/RESUME T7. Exact TEST policy domain blocks legacy synthetic downgrade. No migration or new public command is assumed; DB schema supports N->D->F same-subject references and immutable typed hashes.
protocol_assessment.time_layers: Actual merged guards use trusted clock_timestamp after locks and have no deterministic equality seam. Actual pure require_live and evaluate_executability predicates reject equality. Packets separately require PU equality and actual DC before/after plus observed-lock-wait expiry; I04@WF remains unfulfilled and cannot be promoted by DC.
protocol_assessment.separation: All five tasks retain isolated TEST subject/principal/policy/environment, no provider/model/network work inside transactions, no planned-to-actual substitution, no executable shadow or production activation. KL026 allows declared synthetic upstream guard inputs only as DC limitations; KL027 full trajectory forbids target-output seeding and waits for normally merged KL075/076/077.
protocol_assessment.projection_checks: Independent read-only validator calls found no definition/packet errors and exact traceability projection for all five tasks (17/12/13/13/14 exact checks respectively). All remain NOT_STARTED with prospective implementation evidence unclaimed. Git diff independently shows no production src, frozen baseline/authorities, requirement set/specs/evidence manifest, completed results or milestone changes.

limitations: No DB/Docker lifecycle or prospective owner implementation was run. This review assesses packet feasibility and protocol meaning, not prospective PU/DC/E2E execution or release readiness.
Committed governance check records were inspected; I did not rerun the eight full governance commands. The suffix blocker was independently reproduced by the actual validator.
No product requirement PASS, M3/G-SHADOW/release closure, provider integration, clinical/model quality, or production ingress/authentication assurance is established.
Fresh review is required after the evidence-binding repair.
